thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: KV cache size anomaly detected in prod-us-east-1 (cont-batch pool). Auto-paging triggered.
Maria: seeing huge KV footprint after last model rollout, paging rate jumped ~7x. Telemetry dashboard spiking.
Ajay: confirmed. Continuous batching queue depth also increased, lots of partial prefixes. Looks like new quantized kernel path is producing larger KV entries for some AWQ/GPTQ builds.
Samir: tagging this P0 until we know customer impact. On-call handoff in 5. @Joanne can you join?
Joanne: on it. Pulling recent traces now.
InfraBot: autoremediation attempted: reduced cont-batch window by 50% for pool=contbatch-1 at 2432109920, but paging still > threshold.
Maria: quick note on scope — replicants across two racks affected, not entire region. A subset of int8/awq variants are main offenders.
Ajay: logs show KV sizes per request jumped from ~1.2MB to ~6.8MB for some sequences. Suspect padding or incorrect dtype packing in the new kernel.
Samir: customer impact check — internal routing shows a handful of high-traffic customers saw 5xxs and degraded tail latency. Not full outage, but error rate up from 0.2% -> 3.5% for those tenants.
Joanne: mitigation plan: 1) rollback quantized kernel selection for affected model family -> force fallback to fp16 kernel; 2) reduce max_batch_tokens and cont-batch window to limit KV growth; 3) enable eviction throttle to avoid mass spills.
Maria: can we do (1) via routing policy change without redeploy? If so do that first.
Ajay: yes. We can change kernel selector at the router level to prefer fp16-compatible kernels for model family 'redwood-awq-*'. Doing dry-run now.
Joanne: dropping config snippet here for rollback:```json
{
  "routing": {
    "model_family": "redwood-awq-*",
    "kernel_preference": ["fp16", "int8"],
    "eviction_mode": "throttle"
  }
}
```
Joanne: applying to canary nodes first. Patch command: `redwoodctl config apply --pool contbatch-1 --file rollback-kernel.json --target canary`
InfraBot: canary apply started at 2432109970, status=ok on 3/3 nodes.
Ajay: canary metrics show KV size median dropped ~60% on canaries after kernel preference change. Good signal.
Maria: start rolling to remainder but keep batch window reduced. Proposed config: `--cont-batch-window-ms=8 --max-batch-tokens=256`
Samir: caution: aggressive batching reduction will increase token cost. We should notify billing ops if we keep it for >2h.
Lucy: on customer comms — I'll open quick status updates for affected tenants. Which customers? list: AcmePayments, NovaSearch.
Maria: AcmePayments is seeing 504s; NovaSearch elevated latency but no 5xxs.
Joanne: rolling config to pool with stagger: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 2-min gap. Running `redwoodctl rollout start --file rollback-kernel.json --stages 10,30,60,100 --pause 120s`
Ajay: rollout stage 10% done at 2432110010, metrics improving. Paging rate halved on stage nodes.
Samir: I recommend enabling eviction throttle limit of 20MB/s to prevent disk I/O avalanche while rollout continues.
Joanne: applied eviction throttle via `redwoodctl cache throttle --pool contbatch-1 --rate 20MB/s`
Maria: traffic shaping note: we also dropped cont-batch window. Observe CPU: minor increase but acceptable.
InfraBot: paging rate decreasing, but we still see some historic oversized KV entries being read back during cold misses. Eviction backlog draining slowly.
Lucy: posting customer note draft: "We're mitigating an issue causing increased latency/occasionally 5xxs for a subset of customers in us-east-1. Root cause: regression in quantized kernel path increasing cache footprint. Mitigation: routing to fallback kernels and temporary batching limits. We'll post updates every 30m." Approve?
Samir: approve. Add ETA: next update in 30m and keep channel open for handoff at the top of the hour.
Joanne: rolling to 100% complete at 2432110040. Post-rollout metrics: KV median size back to baseline, paging rate ~15% above normal but trending down.
Ajay: kernel selector rollback fixed the immediate ballooning. Need follow-up: repro test to root-cause why AWQ int8 path expanded KV size — maybe kernel packing bug with variable padding.
Maria: capturing action items: [Ajay] create deterministic repro and submit kernel bug; [Joanne] create rollback PR & document emergency rollback steps; [Samir] draft incident summary and customer impact table; [Lucy] send customer updates and coordinate billing watch.
Samir: handing off to next on-call at 2432110050. @Ajay you remain primary for root-cause. @Joanne please keep monitoring eviction backlog.
Joanne: acknowledged. I'll keep a 1hr watch and escalate if paging > threshold.
IncidentBot: Incident marked: mitigated -> monitoring. P0 -> P1 for postmortem.
Maria: thanks team. We'll schedule a follow-up postmortem tomorrow.
Ajay: quick debug note for postmortem: attach heap dump and sample KV items from before/after to illustrate size delta. Use `s3://redwood-prod-telemetry/kvcache/dumps/24321*`
Lucy: thanks all, will update customers. :thumbsup:
